name: The Best of the Scarlet Witch
description: After an origin story and a first meeting with Agatha Harkness, the Scarlet Witch's power is tested by Chthon and by her own inner world. Vision and the Scarlet Witch leads to Children's Crusade and Remender's Ragnarok Now. James Robinson's solo series and Ahmed's Quicksilver: No Surrender lead to No Road Home.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
